composition_label: Structured extraction -> Product comparison -> Guided setup

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, synthetic=true, documents[{id,text}], preferences{weights,max_price?,min_storage?}, onboarding{completed,answers,transfer_gb}
shared_schema.output: One envelope with schema_version, synthetic, status, request, extraction, comparison, guided
shared_schema.field_schema: name (required text), price (required USD), storage (required GB), warranty (optional months)
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate() validates requests and each stage handoff; extraction verifies provenance and normalization; comparison and guided outputs are checked against upstream data.
shared_schema.errors: File, JSON and request validation errors produce one JSON object with status=error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: extract -> compare: validated field records, missing fields, completeness and document identity
compare -> guided: validated ranking, selected product ID and normalized storage capacity

behavior.extraction: Case-insensitive line labels Name, Price, Storage, Warranty. Other lines ignored. Duplicate recognized labels and malformed present values rejected. Blank/absent values reported missing. Spans are zero-based half-open Python Unicode character offsets into original text.
behavior.normalization: USD or $ or bare price, decimal GB/TB (1 TB=1000 GB), months/years (1 year=12 months). Nonnegative amounts capped at 1e12 normalized units.
behavior.comparison: All products shown side-by-side. Incomplete products and hard-constraint failures excluded from ranking. Weighted min-max utilities among eligible products: lower price and higher storage/warranty preferred. Missing warranty scores as zero months. Equal attribute values yield utility 1. Scores rounded to 8 decimals; ties use ascending ID. Weights are 0..1, positive total, normalized by their sum.
behavior.guided: Purchase -> configure -> transfer. Completion requires all preceding steps and corresponding evidence (purchase_confirmed, device_name, transfer_confirmed). Transfer also requires selected product storage >= transfer_gb. Evidence alone never auto-completes steps. Progress is completed steps / 3. No eligible product yields blocked setup; prior completions then rejected.
behavior.state: Stateless replay: callers persist completed IDs and answers in subsequent input. No hidden files or side effects.
behavior.fixtures: All example products and answers are explicitly synthetic.

coverage: Strict JSON and CLI success/error behavior
